atoms.reference: Books published in the United States whose authors certify that the text was written by a human and not generated by AI, minimal uses such as spelling and grammar checks or research excepted.

evidence.record_quote: “Human Authored” means that the text of the book was written by a human and not generated by AI, with the exception of minimal uses such as AI applications that check spelling and grammar or for research.
Human Authored certification is available to all authors with books published in the United States who agree to the licensing terms.

atoms.reference: To allow an author to certify that their book is created by a human, and to distinguish human creativity in an increasingly AI world.

evidence.record_quote: Human Authored is a project of the Authors Guild that allows an author to certify that their book is created by a human.
Distinguish human creativity in an increasingly AI world.

atoms.reference: A licensing agreement for every certifying author; identity verification through a third-party service and $10 per title for non-members, both waived for members; a public database; a certification mark under usage guidelines.

evidence.record_quote: Identity Verification Not required Required Cost Free! (included in dues) $10/title
You will have to verify your identity through a third-party service and pay a $10/title registration fee.
Membership is not required but the $10/title fee and identity verification requirement are waived for Authors Guild members.
Usage guidelines for the Human Author certification mark

atoms.reference: A Human Authored registration number for each certification, searchable in the public database with title and authors.

evidence.record_quote: Human Authored certifications are listed in a public database where anyone can verify a book’s human origins. You can search for a title, authors, or Human Authored registration number to see and confirm the certification details.
